SCN_SALT.description: Generate a unique random string for password hashing (for example, `openssl rand -hex 32`).

SCN_SECRET.description: Generate a unique random secret for signing sessions and tokens (for example, `openssl rand -hex 32`).

SCN_ADMIN_PW.description: Choose a strong password for the admin dashboard. The admin route is configured separately with SCN_ADMIN_PATH.

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Optional. Add a Groq API key to enable hosted AI transcription and writing features.

SCN_STORAGE_DRIVER.description: Storage mode: `auto` uses D1 with KV fallback; `kv` uses KV only; `d1` uses D1 only.

SCN_APP_NAME.description: Optional. App name displayed in the interface.

SCN_ADMIN_PATH.description: Admin dashboard route. Default: `/admin`. Choose a less predictable route if desired.

SCN_SLUG_LENGTH.description: Length of generated note URLs. Default: `4`.

SCN_ENABLE_R2.description: Enable image uploads to the R2 bucket. Default: `1`.

SCN_R2_DOMAIN.description: Optional custom public image domain. Leave empty to serve images through the Worker.

SCN_ENABLE_WEBTALK.description: WebTalk is disabled by default. Set to `1` only after configuring your own WebTalk values.

SCN_WEBTALK_SCRIPT_URL.description: Optional. Your WebTalk client script URL. Required to enable your own WebTalk widget.

SCN_WEBTALK_AI_ENDPOINT.description: Optional. Your WebTalk AI endpoint. Required to enable your own WebTalk widget.

SCN_WEBTALK_SITE_ID.description: Optional. Site ID registered with your WebTalk service.

SCN_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID.description: Optional. Your Google Analytics measurement ID.

SCN_ENABLE_NOTE_HISTORY.description: Enable D1 note history, statistics, and annotations. Default: `1`.

SCN_NOTE_HISTORY_LIMIT.description: Maximum retained note history versions. Default: `10`.

SCN_NOTE_HISTORY_MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: Minimum interval between automatic history snapshots in seconds. Default: `300`.
